improvements: The bot remembers when a sleeping enemy guards optional food, even after the enemy leaves view. It can continue shopping instead of turning back, while keeping the food unfinished and preserving required pickups.
incoming_learnings: Losing sight of a known sleeping enemy must not restart optional food collection that reverses existing shopping. Keep unfinished loot honest, preserve mandatory progression pickups, and clear remembered guards only through fresh public evidence.

review.review: The hero remained alive at 24/30 HP when the planner stopped. The initiating defect was conflicting escape rules: toxic-gas escape chose a dry piranha bank, and special-room escape returned to the gas threshold. Decision 1033, log lines 3164–3166, enters bank 396; decision 1034, lines 3167–3169, reverses to 451. Repetition eventually exhausted the navigation guard at decision 1046, lines 3205–3208. The clock advanced during this loop. The preceding unknown-potion test was only a hypothesis before consumption; its observed gas effect, not an assumed identity, informed escape. Nearby enemies do not establish the source of the final damage. The proposed narrow correction excludes recognized gas-free special-room hazards from gas-escape routes. A reduced public-geometry regression fails on the original selector and passes after correction; the full suite passes 2101 tests with four skips. Snapshot probes and fixtures are not recovered runtime memory, and no later observations were supplied after a changed selection. The adapter supplies changed files; the empty files field is intentional.
review.learnings: Gas-free ground is not necessarily a safe exit: preserve recognized piranha-bank and other special-room exclusions when choosing a gas escape. Reobserve after each step, retain unfinished loot honestly, and keep terminal exhaustion rather than restoring repeated waits. A corrected selection does not establish successful escape or puzzle completion.

recommendations.summary: Prevent toxic-gas escape from selecting recognized hazardous clear ground and reversing special-room retreat.
evidence: Decision 1033, log lines 3164–3166: gas escape enters piranha bank 396 despite an observed alternate route through 504 toward clear floor 557.
Decision 1034, log lines 3167–3169: room escape reverses to threshold 451.
Decisions 1045–1046, log lines 3200–3208: navigation and recovery guards exhaust with the hero alive.
recommendations.reason: Patch passed isolated validation and was accepted.
